messages.name: ENGINE_RPM
messages.description: Engine RPM value (bytes 0-1 = RPM uint16, byte 2 = load %, byte 3 = state)

messages.name: ENGINE_TEMP
messages.description: Engine temperature in 0.1°C units (bytes 0-1 = temp int16)

messages.name: ENGINE_STATUS
messages.description: Engine overall status (byte 0 = state, byte 1 = fault flags)

messages.name: BRAKE_STATUS
messages.description: Brake state (byte 0 = active 0/1, byte 1 = fault flags)

messages.name: BRAKE_PRESSURE
messages.description: Brake pressure in 0.1 bar units (bytes 0-1 = pressure uint16)

messages.name: VEHICLE_SPEED
messages.description: Vehicle speed in 0.1 km/h units (bytes 0-1 = speed uint16)

messages.name: BATTERY_STATUS
messages.description: Battery status (byte 0 = percentage, byte 1 = charging 0/1, byte 2 = fault)

messages.name: BATTERY_VOLTAGE
messages.description: Battery voltage in 0.1V units (bytes 0-1 = voltage uint16)

messages.name: STEERING_ANGLE
messages.description: Steering angle in 0.1° units (bytes 0-1 = angle int16 signed)

messages.name: GATEWAY_STATUS
messages.description: Gateway network health report (bytes 0-4 = ECU health flags)

messages.name: GATEWAY_STATS
messages.description: CAN message statistics (bytes 0-3 = total messages uint32)
